General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The objective of the mission was to Review Project implementation for KMP. Summary of key findings from the mission;
Overall all program development objectives (PDO) are maintained at moderataly satisfactory according to WB. Planning and delivery of infrastucture services have been improved in 15 of Kenyas largest urban centers. The mission indicates that the PDO remains relevant and that the Project indicators and intermediate indicators are appropiate for measuring Project outcomes.
The main objectives of the program are divided under 4 Components; 1) institutional streangthening, 2) participatory strategic Urban development Planning, 3) investments in infrastructure and service delivery 4), Project management, monitoring and evaluation.
Sweden has attended the implementation missions together with the World Bank. The overall objectives of the program have been met and the program is very relevant to the Kenyan context.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
